newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 42.8420/8480 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous close at 42.8375/8475, dealers said.
The local unit opened slightly stronger but slipped later with the demand for the greenback.
"Some banks bought dollar for the payment of import bills," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at 5.5 to 6.0 percent, higher from previous 5.0 to 5.5 percent, dealers said.
